items.headline: $XTEN Airdrop Lands Nov. 29 Ahead of Trading Debut
items.summary: Extended set its $XTEN airdrop for Nov. 29, with points holders needing to sign before 3:30 a.m. ET to make the first batch. Vault depositors must stake $XTEN to earn Extra Yield.

items.headline: $CC Bridge to BNB Opens via LayerZero, Hits PancakeSwap
items.summary: LayerZero opened a Canton Coin bridge to BNB Smart Chain, letting traders swap bridged $CC on PancakeSwap. It says $CC is backed one-for-one by native Canton Coin.

items.headline: $PUMP Launchpad Adds 'Block0' Fee on New Coins Dec. 4
items.summary: Pump.fun plans a Block0 fee on new launches from Dec. 4, exempting only each coin's creator wallet. The fee rate is still unannounced, a notable shift for the $PUMP memecoin pipeline.

items.headline: $ENA: Ethena Kills sUSDe Unstaking Wait
items.summary: Ethena's risk committee backed instant sUSDe unstaking with safeguards, though early explorer checks still showed a 24-hour cooldown. A meaningful DeFi UX shift for the $ENA ecosystem.

items.headline: $VVV Slides as Venice AI Founder Defends Privacy
items.summary: Erik Voorhees said some Private-labeled models run on outside servers under no-retention deals. Venice's $VVV fell 13.5% in two hours while Bitcoin barely moved.
